correction_recorded: My first draft of the docstring, FINDING and PLAN said a symlinked intermediate 'surfaces as ELOOP'. The self-test failed on that assertion: Linux returns ENOTDIR because O_DIRECTORY is consulted before O_NOFOLLOW. The guard worked and my wording named the wrong code. Both codes are inside the review's closed enum, so the operator sees a refusal either way; corrected in all three places because the claim would have read as a defect against real output.
